_about: Datasets the app relies on. The UI, PDF/Excel reports and docs cite these by id as numbered references [n] with links. Each entry was checked on 2026-09-26. 'used_for' says where the numbers enter the plan; 'note' flags caveats.

bls_cex_2022.title: Consumer Expenditure Surveys, Table 1101: Quintiles of income before taxes, 2022
bls_cex_2022.used_for: Spending-level slider: category mix and the income-group milestones (lowest to highest 20%)

bls_cex_2024.title: Consumer Expenditures — 2024 (news release)
bls_cex_2024.used_for: Grows the 2022 quintile spending to 2024 totals ($78,535 average per household)

bea_rpp_2024.title: Regional Price Parities by State and Metro Area, 2024 (via FRED release tables)
bea_rpp_2024.used_for: City and state price levels: goods and services scale everyday spending, the rents index scales rent when you move

worldbank_pli.title: Price level ratio of PPP conversion factor (GDP) to market exchange rate (PA.NUS.PPPC.RF)
worldbank_pli.note: Rough: economy-wide, dated and sensitive to exchange rates

numbeo.title: Cost of Living database (crowdsourced)
numbeo.used_for: Cross-check of international city templates in the 2026 audit

mit_living_wage.title: Living Wage Calculator
mit_living_wage.used_for: Basis of the original v0.8 location templates (kept as the 'v0.8 original' option and for children)

hud_fmr.publisher: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development
hud_fmr.title: Fair Market Rents
hud_fmr.used_for: Rent index for places without BEA data

childcareaware_2024.title: Child Care in America: 2024 Price & Supply
childcareaware_2024.used_for: Daycare costs in children's templates (national average $13,128 a year)

collegeboard.title: Trends in College Pricing
collegeboard.used_for: College tuition, fees, room and board in children's templates

fed_scf_2022.title: Changes in U.S. Family Finances from 2019 to 2022: Evidence from the Survey of Consumer Finances (Table 2)
fed_scf_2022.used_for: Net worth vs. people your age (median and mean by age)

bea_saving_rate.publisher: U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis via FRED
bea_saving_rate.title: Personal Saving Rate (PSAVERT)
bea_saving_rate.used_for: Typical US saving rate shown next to yours

damodaran_sp500.title: Historical Returns on Stocks, Bonds and Bills: S&P 500 including dividends
damodaran_sp500.used_for: Historical S&P 500 returns (Monte Carlo historical mode, historical average button)
damodaran_sp500.note: The app's 100-year list (1924–2023) comes from v0.8; four years that disagreed with this series by >2 points were corrected

bls_cpi.title: Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers (CPI-U), series CUUR0000SA0

cms_nhe.title: National Health Expenditure Data: Historical
cms_nhe.used_for: Healthcare inflation default (health spending has outgrown general prices)

irs_2024_tax.title: IRS provides tax inflation adjustments for tax year 2024 (Rev. Proc. 2023-34)
irs_2024_tax.used_for: Federal brackets and standard deduction (indexed to inflation after 2024)

irs_401k_2026.title: 401(k) limit increases to $24,500 for 2026, IRA limit increases to $7,500

irs_hsa_2026.title: Rev. Proc. 2025-19: 2026 HSA limits ($4,400 self-only, $8,750 family)

ssa_wage_base.title: Contribution and Benefit Base
ssa_wage_base.used_for: Social Security tax wage cap (FICA) and benefit estimates

ssa_bend_points.title: Benefit formula bend points
ssa_bend_points.used_for: Quick Social Security estimate in guided setup

ssa_claiming.title: Retirement age and benefit reduction
ssa_claiming.used_for: Claiming at 62–70: early reduction and delayed credits

ssa_trustees_2026.title: 2026 Trustees Report: combined trust funds pay full benefits until 2034, then 83% (OASI alone: late 2032, 78%)
ssa_trustees_2026.used_for: Social Security shortfall year and size (default cut of 30% is more cautious than the Trustees' 17–22%)

cms_partb_2026.title: 2026 Medicare Parts A & B Premiums and Deductibles ($202.90/month standard Part B premium)

cms_partd_2026.title: 2026 Medicare Part D Bid Information (base beneficiary premium $38.99/month)
cms_partd_2026.used_for: Part D premium reference (the app's $55 default includes a typical plan's extra over the base premium)

kff_ehbs_2025.title: 2025 Employer Health Benefits Survey (workers pay $6,850 a year toward family coverage)

taxfoundation_state_2025.title: 2025 State Individual Income Tax Rates and Brackets
taxfoundation_state_2025.used_for: Reference for the state income tax table
taxfoundation_state_2025.note: The app's state table comes from v0.8 and uses one flat or top rate per state

oecd_taxing_wages_2025.title: Taxing Wages 2025
oecd_taxing_wages_2025.used_for: Reference for the rough effective income-tax rates used for other countries
oecd_taxing_wages_2025.note: The app's country rates are v0.8 estimates, not taken from this report

kff_benchmark_2026.title: Marketplace Average Benchmark Premiums (40-year-old: $625/month in 2026, $497 in 2025)

cms_age_rating.title: Market Rating Reforms (age rating up to 3:1 on the federal default age curve)
cms_age_rating.used_for: Why marketplace premiums at 60+ are about twice a 40-year-old's

irs_pub555.title: Publication 555, Community Property (community-property states; how income from separate property is treated)
irs_pub555.used_for: Default rules for separate vs marital property: the nine community-property states, and the four (ID, LA, TX, WI) where income from separate property is community income

lii_equitable.publisher: Cornell Law School, Legal Information Institute
lii_equitable.title: Equitable distribution
lii_equitable.used_for: How non-community-property states divide marital property (by fairness factors, not always 50/50)

snaptrade_personal.title: SnapTrade Personal vs Commercial (free Personal keys for your own accounts)
snaptrade_personal.used_for: Optional automatic, read-only balance sync from Fidelity and other brokerages

snaptrade_sync.title: Syncing and Data Freshness (holdings refresh once a day)

snaptrade_fidelity.title: Fidelity integration (read-only, OAuth sign-in at Fidelity)
snaptrade_fidelity.used_for: What the Fidelity connection can read

irs_rmd.title: Retirement topics — Required minimum distributions (RMDs): start at 73; none for Roth IRAs or designated Roth accounts while the owner is alive
irs_rmd.used_for: RMDs from pre-tax accounts; Roth accounts exempt

cfr_ult.title: Uniform Lifetime Table (distribution periods by age)
cfr_ult.used_for: RMD amount = prior year-end balance ÷ the table's divisor for your age

fr_secure2_rmd.title: Required Minimum Distributions: SECURE 2.0 applicable age (73 if born 1951–1959, 75 if born 1960 or later)
fr_secure2_rmd.used_for: The age RMDs start for each person

ssa_spousal.title: Benefits for Spouses (up to 50% of the worker's benefit; as little as 32.5% if claimed at 62)
